caption: A remote-control boat slows and stops in the middle of a pond as its battery runs flat.

sa.check: A remote-control boat on a pond.
The boat stops in the middle of the pond.
The boat is moving under its own power at the start: a wake or bow wave shows.
The order is moving, slowing, stopped.

pc.expect: The boat loses speed gradually and comes to a stop; it does not speed up again.
pc.fail: The boat runs at full speed to the end of the clip; or speeds up again after slowing; or stops and sets off again under power; or the boat stops dead in an instant with its wake vanishing at once.

pc.expect: Once stopped the boat drifts only slowly with the water; it does not dart off or turn sharply by itself.
pc.fail: The stopped boat darts forward or backward; or spins in place; or moves against the ripples with nothing driving it; or drifts fast across the pond.

pc.expect: As it slows the boat keeps its heading and its wake dies away behind it; the bow wave flattens.
pc.fail: The boat turns sharply as it slows with nothing steering; or reverses; or the wake persists behind a stopped boat; or the wake runs ahead of the boat.

pc.expect: The boat floats level on the surface throughout; it does not sink or lift.
pc.fail: The boat sinks lower as it slows; or lifts out of the water; or tips over with nothing pushing it; or the water heaps around a still boat.

pc.expect: One boat on one pond; the boat keeps its hull and fittings; nothing passes through the water's surface or vanishes.
pc.fail: The boat vanishes or a second boat appears; or the boat passes through a reed bed or the bank; or the hull changes shape; or the boat sinks through the surface without any water entering.

pc.expect: The boat's colours and the pond's surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The boat changes colour; or its fittings change; or the surroundings rearrange.

note: Whoever holds the controller is out of view and is not judged; how quickly the boat slows is not judged.
